0	[Music]	[Música]
1	This week's Parashah, Parashat Balak. This week
2	falls the yahrzeit of Rabbenu the Holy Or HaChaim.	cai o aniversário de falecimento de Rabênu, o santo Or HaChaim.
3	Not many of the great sages of Israel are called by the name
4	"the Holy."	"o Santo."
5	The Holy Or HaChaim
6	was a great Kabbalist,
7	and on the other hand he was also an immense Torah genius. He
8	combined Pshat and Kabbalah.	combinou o Pshat e a Cabalá.
9	Sadly, he passed away at the age of 47. Very young,
10	but in his lifetime he managed to write many, many
11	books.	livros.
12	The most famous book is the Holy Or HaChaim
13	on the Torah,	sobre a Torá,
14	but he has other books. He has a book called Peri
15	To'ar. Peri To'ar is a large, deep and very powerful book
16	on the laws of forbidden and permitted. Shulchan Arukh,
17	Yoreh Deah. He has a book, Rishon LeTsion.
18	Rishon LeTsion on some of the tractates of the Shas, with immense
19	and wonderful pilpulim.	e maravilhosas discussões analíticas.
20	He also has a book, Chefets HaShem, on the tractates of the Shas,
21	on halachah and aggadah.	sobre halachá e agadá.
22	Many, many very important books, but
23	the book that all of Israel loves to study is the Holy Or
24	HaChaim. The Or HaChaim is a book that investigates
25	and expounds the language of the verses, to understand also
26	sublime ideas of Mussar that are in this book, and on the other hand there is
27	in it also a great deal of halachot, a great deal of pilpul
28	of Torah law, a great and wondrous book.	um livro grande e maravilhoso.
29	I heard from my father, my teacher, Maran Rabbenu Ovadia Yosef, may the memory of
30	the righteous and holy be a blessing,
31	that every person who suffers from an illness of the eyes
32	should study the Holy Or HaChaim.
33	Reading the Holy Or HaChaim sanctifies
34	the eyes and also heals them. And Dad told me
35	that when he was ill, suffering from eye pains, he studied
36	the Or HaChaim on the Parashah and he became healthy. This is
37	a segulah. That is to say, the Holy Or HaChaim was entirely
38	holy, and his books too are full of holiness.
39	By his light we shall walk, and his merit will protect us. Amen. May it be so.	À luz dele andaremos, e o mérito dele nos protegerá. Amém. Assim seja.
